SEc. 2. Section 4 of Executive Order No. 440, dated
May 8, 1951, is hereby repealed by setting up new reduced
cailing prices for locally manufactured nails as follows:
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS (LOCAL)
Producer's Wholesaler's Retailer's
Common, wire nails (local)-.
Keg/100# P31.00/keg P33.00/keg PO.80/kilo
Keg/100# 29.00/keg 31.00/keg 0.75/kilo
... Keg/100# 27.00/keg 29.00/keg 0.70/kilo
•
Finishing Nails (Local)-
Keg/100# 33.00/keg 35.00/keg 0.85/kilo
Keg/100# 31.00/keg 33.00/keg 0.80/kilo
3" up ... Keg/100# 29.00/keg 31.00/keg 0.75/kilo

The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include
the 7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of February,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
